title: Rebalance Holdings
allocationUncertain: Allocation mode save could not be confirmed. Reload before trying again; this request changes only the allocation preference.
pooledCash: Unspent money stays in your cash balance, is not reserved for any fund, and is divided again by the gaps next time. Whole-unit and minimum-order limits apply in both modes.
unspentShare: {fund}: ₪{unspent} of this plan's share was not spent (one unit costs ₪{cost})
editorCaption: Edit Value or Units; the last field edited sets the holding. Values are ₪ for ILS funds and $ for US funds; units are saved. TASE value entry rounds down to whole units; no difference is added to cash.
addCaption: Adding a fund keeps your entries. New rows and edits are saved together with Save holdings.
customCaption: Not listed? Add the actual security, not a proxy or index.
automaticCaption: Price and date are fetched automatically. Manual override fields can stay blank. Prices are native currency per ONE unit, not agorot or cents. Minimum 0 means unknown/not configured.
manualCaption: Enter the date of the price you are copying.
fxCaption: Optional: dated broker exchange rate in ₪ per $1. Clear it to use the indicative feed.
reloadConfirm: Reload saved holdings and discard this local draft?
loading: Loading shared holdings, prices and completed targets…
error: The operation could not be confirmed. Your draft is unchanged.
unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
validation: Check the entered fields. No data was saved.
paused: Sync paused: reload before saving. Nothing was overwritten by this request.
uncertain: Save response uncertain. Read-back was attempted without repeating the write. Keep this draft and reload before saving again.
conflictDetails: The workspace revision changed since this page loaded. Another tab or concurrent request can cause this, not necessarily another device. A conflict does not overwrite holdings. Reload before saving; safeguards remain active.
changed: Inputs changed, press What to buy again
missing: Price missing or stale — enter a dated manual price in the affected row:
heldBlocked: A held fund needs a current manual price before accurate account weights or buys can be calculated.
fxMissing: USD/ILS is missing or stale. Enter its dated override below the holdings editor.
fullTotal: Full account value (including outside holdings + cash)
fullMissing: Full account value unavailable: a holding price or FX rate is missing.
overweight: Overweight, buy-only so nothing to buy
singleOrder: Buy-only funding prioritises the largest ₪ shortfalls, subject to whole units and minimum orders—not a fixed split of each deposit.
emptyPlan: No whole-unit order fits the budget, targets and configured minimums.
partial: Partial buy list: unpriced, unheld funds were skipped. Targets were not redistributed.
recordCaption: After trading, enter units actually bought and actual ₪ paid (including fees charged to this cash budget). For USD orders, enter the ₪ equivalent you actually used. Zero means not bought. Unspent cash stays in this shared account.
acknowledge: I confirm these purchases and the cash deposited. This does not place orders.
done: Done — record buys and remaining cash
recorded: Confirmed units and remaining cash saved to your shared account.
pricesCaption: Actual unadjusted prices only. Public/delayed observations are not guaranteed fills. Five-minute caches. Manual prices are native currency per ONE unit, not agorot or cents.
fundCaption: Mutual-fund prices are published redemption valuations, not live or guaranteed purchase prices. Publication can lag; stale observations still block sizing. Clear a saved manual price and its date to return to the automatic feed.
costCaption: Existing unallocated cash is included. Unknown order minimums are not invented. Estimates exclude automatically calculated commissions and spreads.
noPortfolio: Save a portfolio on the Portfolio page to compare targets. You can still enter your shared holdings below.
signalCaption: Signal dates identify actionable decisions supplying targets; provisional previews are never targets. These dates do not schedule broker orders.
neverOrders: This page never places orders. Display and record-keeping only; you trade manually at your broker.
